goal_intent: book a table for four and check whether there is parking

turns.utterance: Hi there! I’m organising a little get-together with some friends and wanted to see about reserving a table.
It’ll be four of us—just a nice-sized group for catching up after a busy week. Would Thursday evening work for you?
We were thinking about 7pm, since it’s perfect for unwinding after work and still gives us plenty of time to chat. Should I give you a name for the booking?
Absolutely, the booking can go under Fiona Cadwell. By the way, before we wrap up, I wanted to check—does the restaurant have its own parking, or should we plan to look elsewhere?

Thank you, that sounds perfect! I just wanted to confirm about the parking—does the restaurant provide its own parking lot, or is it street parking? It would help us plan ahead, since one of us is coming straight from work.

That’s really helpful, thank you! We’ll make sure to use the Mercer Street car park. Everything else sounds great, so please go ahead and confirm the booking for Fiona Cadwell, party of four, Thursday at 7pm. 

[END OF CALL]
